This is the latest expansion to the TurboChill™ chiller platform that provides advanced free-cooling, air-cooled chiller heat rejection to meet the high-density cooling demands of next-generation, GPU-powered data centers. The TurboChill™ 3+MW delivers industry-leading heat rejection capabilities and features an expanded operating range for free cooling, reducing the need for mechanical cooling and lowering energy consumption.
